text:
anya: opened PR to clarify rate limits, quotas, and usage analytics. focuses: token vs request metering, per-route dashboard screenshots, and a short migration note for per-minute -> per-second quotas. need 1-2 reviewers before merge.

ben: quick glance looks good. tagging @lucy for SDK snippets and @omar for pricing phrasing. please mark any numbers as TBC.

lucy: i'll add minimal examples: curl, python, and node showing X-RateLimit-* header parsing and Retry-After handling. keeping them compact.

omar: finance hasn't locked final tiers. please leave placeholders and i'll replace when confirmed.

anya: added a canary recommendation in the migration guide (48h, monitor 95th pct 429s). also added a note about metric freshness (~2m lag) to the dashboard captions.

ben: small nit: replace ambiguous "requests" with "metering units (tokens)" across the doc.

lucy: pushed commit with snippets and simple exponential backoff example. sample: ```js
try{ await client.generate(p); }catch(e){ if(e.status==429) await sleep(1000); }```

anya: docs-bot flagged missing alt text on one image, fixed. preview built: https://deploy-previews.redwood.ai/1765004321

omar: approving content except pricing. will update numbers and ping to merge.

ben: approved for wording. leaving pricing TBC.

anya: plan to merge tomorrow morning after omar updates pricing. marking this thread resolved unless objections. :white_check_mark:
